positions.commentary: The speaker notes that the downside protection and margin of safety principle would have been compromised in Carvana, unlike the cement company investment which did well.
The speaker believes Google was a great business opportunity in 2019, noting it was bought for 'kind of free' and was a great value.
The speaker cites Bill Iren's view that Amazon is still a great value and believes it will double in the next three years.
The speaker mentions HDFC bank trades at two and a half times three times book, compared with US counterparts which trade at one point five times.

thesis: This episode argues that investors should focus on businesses with high tangible assets and credible management to ensure a margin of safety, citing Carvana as a negative example due to bankruptcy risk and lack of assets. Conversely, it highlights Amazon and Google as strong value opportunities with significant growth potential, while identifying HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank as prime Indian banking investments characterized by superior discipline, low leverage, and consistent profitability.
